{{Quote|You have desecrated my Sith temple. How did you escape the purge, Jedi?|Darth Vader|<ref name="SW:GB" />}}
A '''Sith temple''' was built on the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Hanoon|Geddes]] within an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] research base. Like other [[Sith temple/Legends|Sith Temples]], it had a triangular opening at the front and it tapered into two spires at the top. When the ancient [[Jedi artifact/Legends|Jedi artifact]] [[Vor'Na'Tu]] was found on [[Krant]], the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Geddes [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]], it was stored at the Sith Temple.<ref name="SW:GB" /> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="NEC" /> the research base was [[Battle of Geddes|assaulted]] by a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] strike force intent on recovering the artifact. The Temple was destroyed and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Echuu Shen-Jon]] took the Vor'Na'Tu, although he was forced to shatter it when [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] arrived.<ref name="SW:GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
This Sith Temple appears in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''. It shares the same model with the game's other buildable Sith Temples.
